description: Fixes Windows detached channel supervisor reaping, spawn startup race/stderr loss, and strict send silent exit-0
changelog:
**Fixes & Enhancements:**
- feat(channel): add `trellis channel spawn --foreground` and `--ready-timeout` so Windows / host shells that reap detached children on command exit can host supervisors cleanly inside background tasks.
- fix(channel): capture supervisor startup stderr into `<worker>.log` (instead of `stdio: "ignore"`), wait for durable `spawned` event before reporting success, and fail non-zero with log excerpt on startup error or timeout.
- fix(channel): fail non-zero in `trellis channel send --delivery-mode requireKnownWorker|requireRunningWorker` when any target is undeliverable (including dead supervisor PIDs on disk).
- fix(channel): keep `trellis channel run` supervisor attached (`detach: false`) and send with `deliveryMode: "requireRunningWorker"`.
notes: In Windows agent shells that terminate detached processes when a command exits, run `trellis channel spawn ... --foreground` in a background task or use `trellis channel run`.
